origin: Independent N04 source review and the repository's quarantine-before-delete invariant; this contract was not one of the original 25 seed families.
final_observable_contract: A crash or storage failure at each quarantine transition must never report a completed quarantine without a recoverable blob and known source disposition. Unknown outcomes stay pending for reconciliation; source deletion requires durable blob evidence.
source_span: downstream/security/vault.py:179-210 publishes the blob, commits quarantine_items with the default quarantined state, then marks deletion
downstream/security/vault.py:126-137 writes and rereads the blob without a durability flush
counterexample: Termination after the quarantine_items commit but before SetFileInformationByHandle leaves the source present and the row marked quarantined. Immediate blob readback does not prove survival after power loss.
required_evidence: RED fault injection at every intent/blob/DB/disposition/finalization boundary
A persisted pending outcome and an idempotent reconciliation policy that does not silently delete a replacement path
Storage durability verification on the supported Windows filesystem, with honest UNKNOWN when the platform cannot prove it
Native recovery and actual-caller tests, mutation evidence, fresh CodeGraph binding, and independent review
publication_gate: Do not describe N04 quarantine as crash-safe or power-loss durable while this family is open.
